requirements_summary: Workload type: low-volume chat triage + FAQ + appointment-scheduling
Latency target: <300ms p50 for chat turnaround; acceptable p95 up to 800ms for triage flows
Throughput: pilot ~50-200 requests/day, production could scale to 2k/day
Cost sensitivity: high — SMB wants guidance to minimize token cost (batching/caching suggestions)
Model preference: open models are fine; prefer small/efficient models initially, fallback to larger if quality issues
Routing/fallback: want simple region routing (NA primary) and automatic fallback to cheaper model under capacity constraints
Security: need configurable retention TTLs, per-route log redaction, audit logs, SOC2 attestation; clarity on BAA/DPA
